item.description:
1. Find all functions $x(t),~y(t)$ satisfying

    $$x'(t) = y(t) - x(t)$$

    $$y'(t) = 3x(t) - 3y(t) $$

    . Find the Particular pair of functions satisfying $x(0)=y(0)=1/2$

    Solution :

    We solve this by eliminating variables.
